name: Denise R.
story: I ran the breakfast line for 180 people every morning inside. When I got out, I didn't think that counted as anything. A training program helped me see it was three years of real kitchen experience.
advice: Your kitchen time inside is experience. Say it plainly and proudly.

name: Toya M.
story: I was scared no one would hire me in healthcare. A CNA program that works with people with records helped me check my eligibility first, so I didn't waste money.
advice: Check licensing rules before you pay for a program.

name: Carmen L.
story: Cleaning crews gave me a steady first paycheck and a reference. From there I moved up to a lead role.
advice: A first steady job builds the reference that opens the next door.
